articles.title: Asian Para Games, Oct 22 wrap: Sheetal Devi, Solairaj lead India's gold medal run
articles.summary: India enjoyed a productive day at the Asian Para Games in Nagoya, with Sheetal Devi winning two gold medals in archery and Dharmaraj Solairaj defending his men's long jump title with an Asian record. Indian para-athletes added to the gold rush with a sweep of the men's high jump T63 podium and a one-two finish in the women's 400m T47.

articles.summary: The two sides had exchanged draft proposals, which were compared point by point, with the expectation that differences would be discussed in the next round of talks, he said. articles.title: Great Wall To Gateway: Navigating The India–China Capital Flows Across One Border And Two
articles.summary: Summary: The recentrecalibration of the investment regimes on both sides suggests that businesses may once again have opportunities to explore cross-border transactions between India and China. articles.title: Asian Para Games: Where India stands in medal tally after best day with 26
articles.summary: India enjoyed its best day at the Asian Para Games 2026 on Thursday, winning 26 medals, including seven golds, to reclaim fourth place in the standings. The haul took India's overall tally to 88 medals — 21 gold, 26 silver and 41 bronze — with para-athletics continuing to lead the country's charge.

articles.title: Arunachal Pradesh Honours 1962 War Martyr Neelam Tebi
articles.summary: The tribute commemorated Tebi, a jawan of the 5th Assam Rifles who hailed from Nyelam village in Lower Subansiri district and was killed during Operation Bumla in the Kameng sector during the 1962 war. According to military officials, Tebi sustained injuries on October 19, 1962, and died the following day.

articles.title: Why a routine MLC election matters so much in Bihar today
articles.summary: The election to eight legislative council seats in Bihar is unlikely to alter the arithmetic of power in the state. articles.title: Friday taken away: Uttarakhand ends Madrasas' Jumu'ah holiday, forces Sunday break
articles.summary: Uttarakhand has scrapped the Friday holiday at recognised madrasas and moved their weekly break to Sunday, a step critics see as targeting minority institutions after the state abolished its Madrasa Board. Uttarakhand has ended the long-standing Friday holiday at madrasas recognised as schools, replacing it with the regular Sunday weekly break under a new framework for minority educational institutions.

articles.title: Assam girl allegedly abducted from South Kamrup rescued in Tamil Nadu, man arrested

articles.title: Australian teen threatens to blow up Indian neighbours, charged with hate crime

Area-wise, the AQI around Akshardham Temple stood at 237.
articles.title_hi: दिल्ली-NCR में वायु गुणवत्ता खराब, GRAP चरण 1 उपाय लागू
articles.summary_hi: दिल्ली की वायु गुणवत्ता गुरुवार को 'खराब' श्रेणी में रही, सरकार के AQI डैशबोर्ड पर सुबह 10:31 बजे वायु गुणवत्ता सूचकांक (AQI) 299 दर्ज किया गया, जबकि निजी वायु गुणवत्ता निगरानी मंच IQAir ने सुबह 9:30 बजे 242 AQI दर्ज किया। क्षेत्र के अनुसार, अक्षरधाम मंदिर के आसपास AQI 237 रहा।
articles.title_hinglish: dilli-NCR men vayu gunavatta kharab, GRAP charana 1 upaya lagu
articles.summary_hinglish: dilli ki vayu gunavatta guruvara ko 'kharaba' shreni men rahi, sarakara ke AQI daishaborda para subaha 10:31 baje vayu gunavatta suchakanka (AQI) 299 darja kiya gay, jabaki niji vayu gunavatta nigarani mancha IQAir ne subaha 9:30 baje 242 AQI darja kiya। kshetra ke anusar, aksharadhama mandira ke aasapasa AQI 237 raha।

articles.title: SBI data leak: 'Customer balances are completely safe,' State Bank of India assures users
articles.summary: The bank has launched an investigation. In its post on X, SBI said the suspected cyber incident had not materially affected its IT infrastructure, core business operations, financial performance or business continuity. The State Bank of India (SBI) has assured customers that their money remains safe following a suspected data leak involving customer records found on the dark web.
articles.title_hi: एसबीआई डेटा लीक: 'ग्राहक शेष पूरी तरह से सुरक्षित हैं,' भारतीय स्टेट बैंक ने उपयोगकर्ताओं को आश्वासन दिया
articles.summary_hi: बैंक ने जांच शुरू कर दी है. एक्स पर अपने पोस्ट में, एसबीआई ने कहा कि संदिग्ध साइबर घटना ने उसके आईटी बुनियादी ढांचे, मुख्य व्यवसाय संचालन, वित्तीय प्रदर्शन या व्यवसाय निरंतरता को प्रभावित नहीं किया है। भारतीय स्टेट बैंक (एसबीआई) ने ग्राहकों को आश्वासन दिया है कि डार्क वेब पर पाए गए ग्राहक रिकॉर्ड से जुड़े एक संदिग्ध डेटा लीक के बाद उनका पैसा सुरक्षित रहेगा।
articles.title_hinglish: esabiaaee deta lik: 'grahaka shesha puri taraha se surakshita hain,' bharatiya steta bainka ne upayogakartaon ko aashvasana diya
articles.summary_hinglish: bainka ne jancha shuru kara di hai. eksa para apane posta men, esabiaaee ne kaha ki sandigdha saibara ghatana ne usake aaeeti buniyadi dhanche, mukhya vyavasaya sanchalan, vittiya pradarshana ya vyavasaya nirantarata ko prabhavita nahin kiya hai। bharatiya steta bainka (esabiaaee) ne grahakon ko aashvasana diya hai ki darka veba para pae gae grahaka rikorda se judaे eka sandigdha deta lika ke bada unaka paisa surakshita rahega।

articles.title: Six protesters injured as police fire tear gas in Manipur’s Kangpokpi
articles.summary: Tensions escalated as Chief Minister Yumnam Khemchand Singh and Home Minister Govindas Konthoujam attended the first Manipur State Poomsae Taekwondo Championship at the Khuman Lampak Sports Complex in Imphal West. According to sources, angry demonstrators attempted to march towards the venue, objecting to the ministers’ participation in the event while the state was mourning the killings.

articles.title: ‘Anti-India hate is exploding and Big Tech is profiting’: Raja Krishnamoorthi urges
articles.summary: Illinois Democrat cites 240% spike in hate posts on X; 105 lawmakers urge FBI probe into Aurora Hindu temple shooting attempt US Congressman Raja Krishnamoorthi has flagged a sharp rise in anti-Indian, anti-South Asian and anti-Hindu hate on social media, accusing major technology companies of profiting from online hatred and calling on Congress to hold them accountable.

articles.title_hinglish: 'bharata virodhi napharata phaila rahi hai aura biga teka munapha kama rahi hai': raja krishnamurti ka aagraha
articles.summary_hinglish: ilinoisa demokreta ne eksa para napharata bhare poston men 240% badhaोtari ka havala diy; 105 sansadon ne arora hindu mandira men golibari ke prayasa ki ephabiaaee jancha ka aagraha kiya hai। ameriki kangresi raja krishnamurti ne soshala midiya para bharata virodhi, dakshina eshiyaee virodhi aura hindu virodhi napharata men teja vriddhi ko chihnita kiya hai, pramukha praudyogiki kanpaniyon para ऑnalaina napharata se labha kamane ka aaropa lagaya hai aura kangresa se unhen javabadeha thaharane ka aahvana kiya hai।

articles.title: Weather Today, October 20: Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, Kerala & Karnataka on rain alert; IMD
articles.summary: Weather Today, October 20 (Google Trends): The IMD has forecast heavy rainfall across Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Karnataka and parts of Andhra Pradesh from October 20 onwards. Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karaikal may receive isolated very heavy rainfall till October 21, while Kerala is likely to see heavy rain till October 25.

articles.title: 'India-based' D-Company tag: New Delhi rebukes UN rapporteur, flags 'glaring inaccuracies'
articles.summary: India has pushed back against a United Nations special rapporteur’s description of fugitive gangster Dawood Ibrahim’s D-Company as an “India-based” criminal group, flagging “glaring inaccuracies” in a counter-terrorism report. India warned that such factual errors, coupled with a lack of accountability for UN experts, risk undermining the credibility of the world body.

articles.title_hinglish: 'bharata sthita' di-kanpani ka taig: naee dilli ne sanyukta rashtra ke duta ko phatakara lagaee, 'ganbhira ashuddhiyan' bataeen
articles.summary_hinglish: bharata ne sanyukta rashtra ke vishesha prativedaka dvara bhagodaे gaingastara daooda ibrahima ki di-kanpani ko "bharata-aadharita" aaparadhika samuha ke rupa men varnita kie jane ka virodha kiya hai aura aatankavada virodhi riporta men "spashta ashuddhiyon" ko ujagara kiya hai। bharata ne chetavani di ki isa taraha ki tathyatmaka trutiyan, sanyukta rashtra visheshajnyon ke lie javabadehi ki kami ke sath, vishva nikaya ki vishvasaniyata ko kama karane ka jokhima uthati hain।

articles.title: US Postal Service releases new Diwali postage stamp featuring Indian artist's rangoli art
articles.summary: The US Postal Service has introduced a new postage stamp to commemorate the festival of Diwali. This stamp features a beautiful rangoli design created by Sangita Bhutada, an artist based in Houston. The stamp was unveiled at a ceremony attended by India's Ambassador to the US, Vinay Mohan Kwatra, and USPS officials.
articles.title_hi: अमेरिकी डाक सेवा ने भारतीय कलाकारों की रंगोली कला को दर्शाने वाला नया दिवाली डाक टिकट जारी किया

articles.title_hinglish: ameriki daka seva ne bharatiya kalakaron ki rangoli kala ko darshane vala naya divali daka tikata jari kiya
articles.summary_hinglish: ameriki daka seva ne divali ke tyohara ke upalakshya men eka naya daka tikata pesha kiya hai। isa daka tikata men hyustana sthita kalakara sangita bhutada dvara banaee gaee eka sundara rangoli dijaाina hai। isa daka tikata ka anavarana eka samaroha men kiya gaya jisamen amerika men bharata ke rajaduta vinaya mohana kvatra aura yuesapiesa adhikari shamila hue।

articles.title_hinglish: ilektroniksa aura aaeeti ke lie vishveshvaraiya piechadi yojana (2014): nirmana ke lie bharata ke prayason ka aakalana

articles.title: Shiv Sena defends public protests against Modi government as democratic
articles.summary: On Thursday, the Shiv Sena Uddhav Balasaheb Thackeray party defended public protests against the government as democratic dissent. An editorial in its mouthpiece criticised remarks by Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh chief Mohan Bhagwat linking agitations to instability. The party argued that public mobilisation holds leaders accountable and is essential for addressing grievances involving inflation, unemployment, and governance failures.
articles.title_hi: शिवसेना मोदी सरकार के खिलाफ जनता के विरोध प्रदर्शन को लोकतांत्रिक बताती है

articles.title_hinglish: shivasena modi sarakara ke khilapha janata ke virodha pradarshana ko lokatantrika batati hai
articles.summary_hinglish: guruvara ko, shivasena uddhava balasaheba thakare parti ne sarakara ke khilapha sarvajanika virodha pradarshana ko lokatantrika asahamati ke rupa men bachava kiya। isake mukhapatra ke eka sanpadakiya men rashtriya svayansevaka sangha pramukha mohana bhagavata dvara aandolanon ko asthirata se jodane vali tippani ki aalochana ki gaee hai। parti ne tarka diya ki sarvajanika lamabandi netaon ko javabadeha banati hai aura mudrasphiti, berojagari aura shasana ki viphalataon se sanbandhita shikayaton ke samadhana ke lie aavashyaka hai।

articles.title: Voting begins for first phase of Rajasthan local body polls across 16 districts
articles.summary: Polling began at 7 am on Thursday in the first phase of Rajasthan’s three-phase Panchayati Raj elections, with more than 85 lakh voters eligible to elect representatives to 16 zila parishads and 104 panchayat samitis across 16 districts. A total of 6,976 candidates are contesting 2,081 seats in this phase, including 293 zila parishad wards and 1,788 panchayat samiti wards.

articles.summary_hinglish: kya sonama vangachuka ko jabaradasti khana khilaya ja sakata hai? yaha savala taba utha jaba jalavayu karyakarta aura shiksha sudharaka sonama vangachuka ko 21 dinon ki anishchitakalina bhukha hadatala ke bada dilli ke saphadarajanga aspatala men sthanantarita kara diya gaya। eka janahita yachika (piaaeeela) men yaha tarka dete hue tatkala chikitsa hastakshepa ki manga ki gaee thi ki unaka svasthya kaphi kharaba ho gaya hai, jisamen jabaradasti khana khilana bhi shamila hai। halanki, uchcha nyayalaya ne jabaradasti khilane ka aadesha nahin diya।

articles.title: Sensex Jumps Over 1,100 Points as Finance Minister’s Tax Comments Lift Indian Markets

articles.title: Elon Musk clashes with Indian officials over Starlink market access
articles.summary: Billionaire Elon Musk recently accused Indian officials of maintaining a monopoly to block Starlink services. The Indian government swiftly dismissed the claims as baseless, noting that all satellite operators must complete security compliance. This high-profile dispute highlights growing tensions between powerful technology leaders and democratic institutions globally as external actors increasingly attempt to influence domestic policy and regulatory decisions.

articles.title: Govt Launches Nationwide Financial Inclusion Campaign at Panchayat, ULB Levels
articles.summary: Last Updated on October 22, 2026 12:01 am by INDIAN AWAAZ The Union Finance Ministry today launched a nationwide Financial Inclusion Campaign, along with other key initiatives, at the Gram Panchayat and Urban Local Body levels. articles.title: Pakistan veterans Team withdraws from World Cup after PCB denies permission to Travel
articles.summary: The Pakistan Cricket Board (PCB) has said no to its over-50s cricket team playing in the International Masters Cricket World Cup in India next January. The team wanted to take part in the tournament, but the board has not given them permission to travel to India. The PCB has also told the Pakistan Veterans Cricket Association about its decision.

articles.summary_hinglish: pakistana kriketa borda (pisibi) ne apani 50 varsha se adhika umra ki kriketa tima ko agale janavari men bharata men hone vale antarrashtriya mastarsa kriketa vishva kapa men khelane se mana kara diya hai। tima turnamenta men hissa lena chahati thi, lekina borda ne unhen bharata aane ki ijajata nahin di hai. pisibi ne apane phaisale ke bare men pakistana vetaransa kriketa esosieshana ko bhi bata diya hai.

articles.title: Houses torched in an abandoned village in Manipur's Kamjong
articles.summary: Tensions have escalated in Kamjong district, Manipur, following the burning of Khoikai Kuki village by suspected militants. More than 50 individuals have lost their lives due to ongoing ethnic clashes between the Kuki and Naga communities since early this year. Manipur's Director General of Police Mukesh Singh visited the district to enhance security coordination among forces addressing the unrest.

articles.summary_hi: आईए दोलरंगनी एफआईआर-ओ जनपानी गीतदे, दिल्ली-ओ अगनग्रीकेंगमिटिंग सोमियो त्रिपुरा ए·डोकनी चादाम्बे सक्साको 'चाइनीज' इन अगेनेंबा, आईए मंडे, त्रिपुरा ए·डोकनी बिमिंगको मत्नांगे, सितंबर-नी 19 तारिको, आईए वीडियो-को सोशल मीडिया-ओ वताथा। इन बिडिंगो, भारतीय न्याय संहिता (बीएनएस), 2023, एआरओ सूचना प्रौद्योगिकी अधिनियम, 2000-नि निंग·ओ एफआईआर-को सेगाचिना गीताबा इया डोलरंग, एफआईआर-ओ पुलिस-को दिदियाताहा।

articles.summary_hinglish: aaeee dolarangani ephaaaeeaara-o janapani gitade, dilli-o aganagrikengamitinga somiyo tripura e·dokani chadambe saksako 'chainija' ina agenenb, aaeee mande, tripura e·dokani bimingako matnange, sitanbara-ni 19 tariko, aaeee vidiyo-ko soshala midiya-o vatatha। ina bidingo, bharatiya nyaya sanhita (bienaesa), 2023, eaarao suchana praudyogiki adhiniyam, 2000-ni ninga·o ephaaaeeaara-ko segachina gitaba iya dolarang, ephaaaeeaara-o pulisa-ko didiyataha।
